name: (04) Thaumaturgy (Path of Mars) — 2 Intermediate — Fearless Heart

system.description:
Reaching past mere tricks of perception, the warrior subtly hardens their own flesh for battle, an enhancement all but undetectable to onlookers.

Once activated, Fearless Heart grants you the Physical Traits Stalwart, Quick and Enduring for the remainder of the scene. You may not stack multiple applications of it, but you may employ it together with Wind Dance or other Discipline powers that grant additional Traits. Retest with Occult.
